name: persian-text-guard
summary: Persian text normalization and evasion-resistant profanity filtering for Python. Folds Arabic/Persian look-alike letters, zero-width and bidi characters, and all three digit ranges, and catches the ways people get around a word list: spaced or dotted letters, held keys, leetspeak, filler symbols, Cyrillic look-alikes and Finglish. Finds every match with its position and censors messages with a fixed mask. Ships an optional curated Persian/Finglish/English word list of about 1,250 categorised entries.
author: Amirehsan Kohannasab
